_comment: Phase 0.3 of road-to-skill-delivery-over-mcp — the incumbent ranker's hit rate, which did not exist before. Regenerate: ./scripts-run src/scripts/measure_skill_ranker_baseline --ranker <label> --commit <sha>. Phase 3.1 records a keyword-v2 row beside this one and is kept only if top3 does not regress.

accuracy.denominator_note: tests/eval/corpus-dev.yaml + corpus-non-dev.yaml — the only expected-skill ground truth in this tree. Small; a single prompt moves each rate by ~4 points.

matrix_coverage.note: tests/eval/routing-matrix/ is labelled with the expected RULE, never a skill, so this arm carries no accuracy — only whether the ranker answers at all and how confident its top answer is. Its size is measured here, not assumed: the roadmap and five other sites still publish 496.

premise_defects_found_by_this_step: The 496-line routing matrix is labelled with the expected RULE, never an expected skill, so no top-1/top-3 accuracy can be computed over it. top1/top3 above are measured against tests/eval/corpus-{dev,non-dev}.yaml, the only expected-skill ground truth in the tree (26 prompts).

496 is stale: the matrix holds 499 prompts at this commit. The figure is still published at src/scripts/hooks/skill_route_hook.ts:24 and :173, src/scripts/hook_manifest.yaml:618, src/config/hook-token-budget.json:71, and in this roadmap. Correcting those six sites is not in this roadmap's scope; the drift is recorded here so the number is not re-derived from 496 again.

The measurement runs against src/skills (292 SKILL.md). score_skill_relevance's own DEFAULT_SKILLS_DIR is .agent-src.uncondensed/skills, which is EMPTY in a normal checkout — a caller that takes the default silently ranks nothing.
